about: Golden cases from section 9 of the build spec, written before the first run and locked by eval/golden.lock.json. Each case changes one thing from case 1 (cases 4 and 5 are a logo deal of their own). Cases are scored on all six statuses, since the verdict follows from them. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected answer, checked once, after the golden cases, and published as they came out.

cases.title: Kiln launch posts
cases.change: The base deal, worded differently on each side
cases.a: Sera writes 3 posts on X about the Kiln launch. All 3 are live by Oct 24, 2026. Kiln pays 600 USDC, all of it after the last post is live.
cases.b: I post three tweets about Kiln's launch, all up by October 24, 2026, for 600 USDC, paid on delivery once the last one is live.
